title: qc-check configuration
description: Every project-specific fact qc-check needs. Lives at the host repository root as qc.config.json.

name.description: Human name of the app under test. Used in report headers only.

reportsDir.description: Root of the structured evidence tree: <reportsDir>/<ticket>/<environment>/<run-id>/, plus index.md and index.json. Relative to the repo root.

locales.description: Languages each screen is checked in.

rtlLocales.description: Subset of locales that render right-to-left. Empty means no RTL checks.

commitReports.description: Keep reports, plans, summaries and screenshots in git. Recordings and the in-progress marker stay ignored either way.

tracker.description: Issue tracker integration. kind 'none' skips ticket fetch and the publish phase.

ticketPattern.description: Regex used to derive a ticket id from the branch name and to validate arguments.

tools.description: Names of the tools the agent should call for each tracker operation. An empty string means the capability is unavailable and the related step is skipped.

rest.description: Jira over REST (qc/tracker.js) instead of agent tools. Credentials come from environment variables, never from this file.

baseUrlEnv.description: Env var holding the Jira site URL.

emailEnv.description: Env var holding the account email.

tokenEnv.description: Env var holding the API token.

acceptanceField.description: Custom field id holding acceptance criteria, e.g. customfield_10040. Empty: they are read from the description.

passLabel.description: Label applied only to a clean PASS run.

blockedLabel.description: Label applied when the blocker is outside the app.

agent.description: Which AI agent the CLI hands the QC workflow to. The workflow is identical for all of them; only the invocation differs.

kind.description: claude and codex are invoked directly. custom uses the command below. none means qc-check only prints the prompt for you to paste.

command.description: For kind custom: the command to run. A {prompt} placeholder is replaced with the QC prompt; without it the prompt arrives on stdin.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the agent invocation, for example a model flag.

headless.description: Run without a human. Auto-approves the test plan and skips publishing. Use for automation, not for work you intend to trust unreviewed.

timeoutMinutes.description: Abort the agent after this long. A full device pass is slow; do not set it low.

repo.description: Version control facts the run needs.

defaultBranch.description: Branch a feature branch is diffed against to find the code under test, and the base for a pull request opened by the fix loop.

prCommand.description: Command that opens a pull request, for example "gh pr create --fill". Empty means derive from the git remote and print the URL instead of opening one.

host.description: Where pull requests live, for `qc-check run pr <n>` and PR review comments (runtime/pr.js). github uses the gh CLI; bitbucket uses the Bitbucket Cloud REST API. Empty detects it from the git remote.

remote.description: The git remote whose URL names the PR host, the owner or workspace, and the repository. build.js also fetches branches from it.

bitbucket.description: Bitbucket Cloud basic auth. Holds the NAMES of environment variables, never their values.

emailEnv.description: Environment variable holding the Atlassian account email.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable holding an Atlassian API token with pull request read (and, to comment, write) scope.

envBanner.description: Text the app shows to mark a non-production build, asserted on the first screen to prove the right flavor is installed. Empty means verify the environment another way.

build.description: Commands that build and install the app on a connected device. {flavor} is replaced with the environment being tested, so one entry serves every environment. Empty means the agent asks before building.

worktreeDir.description: Where runtime/build.js keeps one git worktree per branch under test, relative to the repo root or absolute. Empty means a per-repo folder in the OS temp dir. It must not be the repository or a parent of it.

copyFiles.description: Gitignored files (or folders) the build needs, copied from the main checkout into each worktree, for example ["env/dev.json"]. They are never committed.

flavors.description: Map of flavor name to package identifiers.

devices.description: Form factors the skill may drive. A disabled profile is reported as skipped, never as a pass.

udid.description: Simulator or iPhone udid. Leave empty to let Appium pick a simulator by deviceName; required when realDevice is true.

realDevice.description: Drive a physical iPhone (paired in Xcode 27 Device Hub) instead of a simulator.

teamId.description: Apple developer team id used to sign WebDriverAgent on a real device (appium:xcodeOrgId).

signingId.description: Code-signing identity for WebDriverAgent on a real device (appium:xcodeSigningId).

wdaBundleId.description: Unique WebDriverAgent bundle id for your team, when the default one is taken (appium:updatedWDABundleId).

newCommandTimeout.description: Seconds. QC interleaves device commands with code reading, so a short timeout kills sessions mid-pass.

backend.description: REST contract and smoke checks. Set enabled false for an app with no backend of its own.

baseUrls.description: Map of environment name to base URL.

healthPath.description: Unauthenticated path used to decide whether the gateway is up.

tokenPath.description: Dot-path to the bearer token in the login response, for example data.accessToken. Prefix with headers. to read a response header instead.

extraBody.description: Constant fields merged into the login body.

bodyEncoding.description: How the login body is sent. form sends application/x-www-form-urlencoded, as OAuth token endpoints expect.

headers.description: Headers sent on the login request only, such as an OAuth client Basic header. Values may reference secrets with ${env:NAME} or ${file:path#KEY}.

sessionHeaders.description: Request header name to dot-path in the login response, for a gateway that issues a per-session fingerprint or CSRF value at login. Same path syntax as tokenPath.

guestAuth.description: Optional login that needs no account, used by api.js --guest (e.g. an OAuth client_credentials grant). Keys as in auth: path, method, bodyEncoding, extraBody, headers, tokenPath.

headers.description: Constant headers sent with every request.

smokePath.description: Cheap authenticated GET used to prove a real round trip.

redactKeys.description: Extra body key names api.js masks in saved and printed responses (matched case-insensitively, ignoring punctuation).

protectedEnvs.description: Environments a run may not target without --allow-protected. Names like prod, production, live and release are protected even when not listed.

codeMap.description: Where things live in the host repo, so the skill can read the code under test instead of guessing.

sourceDir.description: Application source root. Searches for a component or a test identifier start here.

navigationGlob.description: Used to build the screen inventory in full-sweep mode.

queriesGlob.description: Read-side data hooks, used by the unit-test phase.

utilsGlob.description: Helpers and pure functions, the cheapest things to unit test.

testsGitignored.description: True when the test folder is gitignored, so committing tests needs an explicit force add.

review.description: Static PR scan (qc/review-scan.js) for the code-review phase. It prints leads, not findings.

lintCommand.description: Linter run by review-scan.js (always when set, or with --lint). {files} becomes the changed files, shell-quoted. Empty with --lint: flutter/dart analyze for a pubspec.yaml repo, npx eslint -f unix when package.json has eslint.

layers.description: Import rules. Empty: built-in data/domain/presentation rules when the repo has <src>/features/*/{data,domain,presentation}.

files.description: Glob (**, *, ?, {a,b}) of the files the rule applies to, repo-relative.

mustNotImport.description: Globs matched against the resolved repo-relative import path, or substrings of the import (e.g. package:dio/).

disable.description: Rule ids to skip, e.g. debug-leftover; lint or layer-import skips every lint:* or layer-import:* rule.

httpClientDirs.description: Directories allowed to construct an HTTP client (Dio, http.Client, axios.create); elsewhere it is a di-bypass lead.

runCap.description: Soft cap for one run. Past it the run prefers finishing the report over more test cases.

perf.description: Limits for the device driver's perf, mem, startup and leak-loop probes (Android). A flag on the command overrides each one.

maxJankPct.description: perf fails when more than this percentage of frames is janky.

maxP90Ms.description: perf fails when the 90th percentile frame time is over this many milliseconds.

maxMemGrowthMb.description: mem --compare and leak-loop fail when TOTAL PSS grows by more than this many MB (an Activity, ViewRootImpl or AppContext count that grows fails too).

maxColdStartMs.description: startup fails when the median launch time is over this many milliseconds. Debug builds are only indicative.

leakLoopTimes.description: How many times leak-loop repeats its steps when --times is not given.

credentialsFile.description: Path, relative to the repo root, of the gitignored file holding the QC test account. Never read or printed directly by the agent.

avd.description: Emulator to auto-boot when it is not already running.

udid.description: Pin a specific running emulator. Leave empty to let Appium choose.

emulatorArgs.description: Extra flags driver.js health --fix passes to the emulator on a cold boot, for example ["-gpu", "swiftshader_indirect"].

capsOverride.description: Raw Appium capabilities merged last, after everything derived from this configuration. The escape hatch for an unusual device, so a one-off capability never needs a schema change.
